items.description: South Africa, Australia and New Zealand currently lead the 2025-27 World Test Championship standings. India are striving to improve their position with crucial upcoming matches. items.author: SHREEDHAR RATHI
items.description: Visakha Eye Hospital has been directed to pay Rs 9 lakh in compensation for negligence during a cataract surgery. Discrepancies in medical records were noted, indicating a failure in the hospital's procedures.
